info.name: vAccount-InstituteAPI — Organization controller
info.description:
Organization controller (route /org) of the vAccount-InstituteAPI service. See vAccount-InstituteAPI.html §9 for the full field reference, error codes, and business rules.

Auth: every request needs TWO cookies — vacc-common-auth (site-wide session) and vacc-<product>-auth (per-product account cookie). There is no bearer token. Use Postman for web with the Postman Interceptor Chrome extension so these are synced automatically from your browser session; see the collection variables below and the HTML guide's "Testing with Postman" note for setup steps.

Set the `baseUrl` variable to the Testing or Production value before sending (Testing is the default).

variable.description: Testing (default). Production: https://api-vacc.vidyaone.com/inst/ — from appsettings.json → App:BaseUrl.
Calling product identifier. Prefix with test- for explicit test mode (e.g. test-lms).
Sample organization id — replace with one you created via 'Create Organization'.

header.description: Sent by VIDYAOne client convention; NOT read or enforced by this endpoint (see HTML guide §9.1 Idempotency note).

request.description: Creates one organization for the caller. 409 DUPLICATE_RECORD if orgName/regNo already exists anywhere; 400 LIMIT_EXCEEDED once the caller already created-or-owns 3 non-deleted organizations. See §9.1.

header.description: Not read or enforced. Effective de-dupe key is orgId (full overwrite) — see §9.2 Idempotency note.

request.description: Updates one organization the caller created or owns, including KYC. 404 if not found/owned/deleted/deactivated, or if KYC is currently Under Review. Every writable field is overwritten — read GET /org/edit first. See §9.2.
Returns one organization in an edit-ready flat shape (rounds-trips into PUT /org). 404 if not found/owned/deleted/deactivated, or KYC is Under Review. See §9.3.

header.description: Not read or enforced. Effective de-dupe key is orgId — repeat call on an already-default org is a no-op. See §9.4.

request.description: Makes one organization the caller's default and clears the flag on their other organizations. Target must be active and not deleted. See §9.4.

header.description: Not read or enforced. NOT safe to retry blindly — a repeat call 404s once the ids are already active. See §9.5a.

request.description: Bulk re-activates one or more previously deactivated organizations owned by the caller. Partial match allowed; 404 only when none of the ids match an eligible (owned, deactivated, non-deleted) organization. See §9.5a.

header.description: Not read or enforced. NOT safe to retry blindly — a repeat call 404s once the ids are already deactivated. See §9.5.

request.description: Bulk-deactivates one or more of the caller's organizations. Clears anyone's default that pointed at a deactivated org. See §9.5.

header.description: Not read or enforced. NOT safe to retry blindly — a repeat call 404s once the ids are already deleted. See §9.6.

request.description: Permanently soft-deletes one or more of the caller's organizations — no undo endpoint. See §9.6.
Returns the caller's active, non-deleted organizations as { id, name } pairs, ordered by name. See §9.7.
Paged list of organizations the caller OWNS (ownerUserId — not merely created), active and deactivated, never deleted. pageNumber/pageSize optional (default 1/50, max pageSize 200). See §9.8.

Read-only display. Not restricted to the caller — any authenticated caller can view any orgId, but gets the full shape only if creator/owner, otherwise a reduced public shape gated on IsActive. See §9.9.
